title: Wharton Global High School Investment Competition evaluation protocol
deliverables: Semifinal and Global Finale presentation if selected

criteria.name: Ability to clearly communicate and defend recommendations

scoring.portfolio_performance_rule: Success is not determined by portfolio performance.
scoring.selection_process: Judges review final reports to select 50 semifinalist teams; semifinal presentations determine the ten Global Finale teams.
scoring.note: No total or criterion weights are published; none is inferred.

provenance.publisher: Wharton Global Youth Program, The Wharton School

sources.title: Wharton Global High School Investment Competition
sources.evidence: Official current competition page states the deliverables, four evaluation considerations, non-use of portfolio performance, and advancement process.

sources.title: Frequently Asked Questions — Deliverables and Judging
sources.evidence: Official FAQ confirms that standings and percentage portfolio growth have little bearing and that organizer scoring details are not provided to teams.

sources.title: Current locally archived organizer page
sources.evidence: Organizer page states that winners are selected on the strength and articulation of team strategies, not portfolio growth.

provenance.applicability_note: This is the currently published protocol. The public pages do not establish that these exact four labels governed the archived 2019-2022 seasons.
provenance.unsupported_gap: Private season materials distributed through SurveyMonkey Apply and any undisclosed judge scorecards are unavailable; no numeric rubric is claimed.
